data.name: Eleshri
data.gender_notes: Eleshri is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Eleshri is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Elu' which means prosperity and 'Shri' which is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. This name is believed to bring abundance and prosperity to the one who bears it. The name Eleshri carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eleshri usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the goddess of wealth and prosperity, invoking blessings of abundance and prosperity.
data.etymology: Eleshri belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eleshri total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_sanskrit.name: ईलेश्री
in_sanskrit.meaning: ईले (Eile) + श्री (Shri) = Famous, Prosperous, Wealthy + ई (I) + ले (Le) + श्री (Shri) = In all worlds
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Eleshri is derived from the Sanskrit words ईले (Eile) and श्री (Shri). Eile means 'Famous, Prosperous, Wealthy'. Shri is a prefix meaning 'Goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity'. The name Eleshri, therefore, means 'Famous in all worlds'. It is a powerful and auspicious name, signifying one who is renowned and respected in all realms of existence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Eleshri is of great cultural significance in Hindu society as it is derived from two sacred Sanskrit words - 'Elu' and 'Shri'. 'Elu' represents prosperity and abundance, while 'Shri' is the goddess of wealth and prosperity. By naming a child Eleshri, parents are instilling the hopes and desires of having their child grow up to be wealthy, prosperous, and successful in life.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond the cultural significance, Eleshri also holds spiritual significance as it is believed that the name is blessed by the goddess Lakshmi, the Hindu goddess of wealth, fortune and prosperity. Devotees of Goddess Lakshmi invoke her name with the prayer for wealth, both material and spiritual, and thus, the name Eleshri becomes an invocation to the goddess, symbolizing her constant presence and blessings in the life of the bearer.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Eleshri: Goddess of pure, radiant joy and inner illumination. Her name is derived from the Sanskrit words "Ela" (beloved) and "Shri" (prosperity, fortune), symbolizing the joy that comes from achieving spiritual wealth.

historical_references.reference: Eleshri, also known as Elasri, was a queen of the Satavahana dynasty in ancient India. She ruled from around 170 CE to 180 CE.
Eleshri is also mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic, as the wife of Bhima, one of the five Pandava brothers. Her exact time period and context in the epic are not well-defined.
